cases.name: Desiree Sue McCartney
cases.about: Her obituary said: "Desiree was a happy, loving child.  She enjoyed dancing and singing at church and especially loved the movie "Frozen" and the character Elsa from the movie."
cases.relationship: Brother / stepbrother / partner or sibling's brother / brother-in-law
cases.narrative:
She died on 5/6/2017. Her brother died 81 days later.

Ripley County Prosecuting Attorney Ric Hertel said the teen admitted suffocating Desiree with a towel after she got out of the bathtub. He told investigators he suffocated Nathaniel with a blanket.

Hertel said the teen made remarks to detectives during the investigation that he was "freeing his siblings from hell."
